newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine telecom firm grants 50 pct rebate.
newsitem.headline: Philippine telecom firm grants 50 pct rebate.

text.p: Philippine telecom firm Bayan Telecommunications Holdings Corp (BayanTel) said on Tuesday it is granting a 50 percent rebate on monthly telephone bills of its residential and corporate customers.

Bayantel senior executive vice-president Rodolfo Salazar said the company, majority-owned by the Benpres Holdings Corp, decided to grant rebates due to the recent bad telephone service their customers suffered as a result of an interconnection problem with dominant carrier Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co.
The rebate will cost BayanTel 20 million pesos, Salazar said in a statement. It will cover the monthly subscription fees of BayanTel subscribers from July 1 up to September 30.
